title: Монументальный портал
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high fidelity finished WEBSITE INTERFACE design comp, a desktop browser viewport without browser chrome, landscape 16:9. This is a Russian-language interactive museum about Ancient Egypt. Show actual purposeful website layout, not a poster. Photorealistic Egyptian sandstone gateway with massive carved pillars and stone lintel, real weathering and fine carved reliefs; golden-hour Giza pyramids through its opening, warm sunset from upper right, ochre, muted terracotta, cream serif type, natural shadows and subtle dust. Egyptian architecture, no Gothic/Roman arches or classical Corinthian columns. Premium art direction, cinematic believable photography and legible intentional interface typography. At top, a quiet integrated header with small brand “ЕГИПЕТ”, navigation “Экспозиция” and “Источники”, and a small outlined sun icon. Main hero title exactly “ЕГИПЕТ”, in elegant high contrast serif, supporting line “Путешествие сквозь тысячелетия”. Modest primary action exactly “Войти в историю” with a small thin arrow. Bottom show a restrained chapter index with “01 / 07”, “Нил”, “Пирамиды”, “Фараоны”, “Письменность”, “Боги”, “Жизнь”, “Наследие”. Include a narrow glimpse of the first reading section under the hero, with tiny number “01” and title “Нил. Начало цивилизации.” on warm parchment; this is a scroll museum rather than an advertisement. Do not invent sponsors, commercial claims, statistics, fake reviews, booking forms, rounded app cards, neon light, ornamental interface grids. Stone framing and scene must be photographic, precise, not plastic or blurry. All core UI text clearly legible. No watermarks, no mockup device, no illustration brushwork. Composition A, THE MONUMENTAL THRESHOLD: The cinematic hero covers 87% of the frame. Symmetric massive Egyptian gateway fills frame, side pylons occupying outer left and right 20%, heavy lintel near upper edge. Camera at human eye height, looking exactly through the central opening to pyramids across the desert. Portal has architectural depth, shaded carved stone glows at its edges. Hero title large but gracefully contained within opening at roughly 55% down, cream text distinct against darker sunlit desert with carefully placed soft shade. One dominant focal moment: the physical gateway and view through it. Header top aligned with generous 48px outer margins. Hero reading order centered, button under title. Lower chapter index anchored flat across the base of the hero, a single fine hairline above. The bottom 13% provides the beginning of the parchment reading section. Full conviction, calm luxurious spacing, highly realistic cinematic portal.
approvalNote: 2026-10-07: пользователь выбрал рекомендованный первый макет — «давай который ты регомендуешь».
